page.overview:
Who is Karui?

Karui is quite self-assured, outspoken, stubborn, combative, and impulsive, allowing her emotions to come out. This was shown when she angrily yelled at Team Kakashi for allowing the renegade Sasuke Uchiha to run loose and cause chaos in Kumo. She came to a violent point when she took out her rage on Naruto Uzumaki and beat him without hesitation, though, according to her partner Omoi, she felt remorse for doing so.

Karui has demonstrated great teamwork skills, able to coordinate attacks with Omoi without either needing to communicate. Nevertheless, she has a somewhat comedically antagonistic relationship with Omoi. During their début, they argued over the possible reasons that the Raikage could have called them. She assumed that he wanted them to get him more protein shakes. However, the argument started with Omoi, implying that she is flat-chested in comparison to their other teammate, Samui. Like the rest of her team, Karui highly respects Killer B and was steadfast in her pursuit of revenge against Sasuke.

As a mother, Karui is close to her daughter Chōchō, who inherited her self-assured personality. She seems laid-back when it comes to the newest generation of Ino-Shika-Cho's training, questioning the necessity for Chōchō and her peers to learn such jutsus in times of peace. She also is patient with her teenage daughter's complains and likes to spend time with her family, though she dislikes when her husband forgets to share food she buys.

Karui is a dark-skinned kunoichi with long spiky red hair and amber eyes. As noted by Omoi in Part II, she was flat-chested.
